children: Lantheus Holdings, Inc. disclosed a 20.9% beneficial stake in Radiopharm Theranostics Limited. The position reflects shares and options accumulated across 2024 and 2025, according to the Schedule 13D filed on September 4, 2026. The investment ties to a broader deal that includes asset transfers and clinical co-development work in radiopharmaceuticals.

Lantheus Holdings built the stake for strategic investment and to support a broader partnership with Radiopharm Theranostics. The group bought rights to two preclinical assets and formed co-development agreements to advance new radiopharmaceuticals in Australia.

The investors say they will keep reviewing the position and could buy more or sell shares. They are also authorized to sell shares through different methods, including private deals, open-market trades, block sales, and derivative transactions.

Lantheus Holdings, Inc. is a Delaware corporation focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing diagnostic imaging agents, radiotherapeutics, and AI-enabled solutions. The company operates globally and is known for products in PET and other advanced imaging modalities. Lantheus often uses targeted partnerships and licensing to expand its radiopharma pipeline and clinical reach.
